title: Law to set up a working group on commercial waste zones
summary: This bill would create a commercial waste zones working group to study how the 2019 commercial waste zone reform has been carried out and recommend policy changes to the Department of Sanitation. The group would include the sanitation commissioner, the Business Integrity Commission chair, the Council sanitation committee chair, carters and Council-appointed members, and would meet for three years after carters begin operating under the zone agreements. The law would take effect immediately.
